role: Partial recovery. Not a restorable image.
provenance: Read-only devmem word reads over the stock Zephyr USB shell of a retail unit. No writes, no erase, no recovery-mode entry, no teardown.

image_layout.note: The first 524,288 bytes of the image were overwritten by 1.1.5; only the tail survives.

verification.method: MCUboot signs the image digest and the digest is carried in the 0x10 TLV, so the signature can be verified without the payload. See verify-1.0.1.py.

why_it_survived: The update path erases only the sectors the incoming image needs rather than bulk-erasing the slot. 1.1.5 ends at 0x93D43, inside the 0x93000 sector, so everything from 0x94000 keeps the older image's bytes.
limits: Partial and not bootable/restorable. Useful for 1.0.x comparison (predates the 1.1.5 Wi-Fi-stack removal) and for recorder/flush analysis.
